rules: Resolve the target module by course slug plus module slug; never hardcode generated module UUIDs in a future migration.
Require exactly one target module and assert sequence 2 and the target lesson slug are unused before any insert.
Insert the lesson initially with is_published=false, then attach reviewed sources and six terms.
Do not create user progress, mastery, Error Bank, review or audio rows as part of curriculum publication.
Run authored-content, source and application regression checks before any separate is_published=true decision.
Recheck current-sensitive official sources at publication time, especially Irish payroll guidance.
publicationDecision: Explicit and separate. This plan is not authorization to write to Supabase or to publish the lessons.
